limitationsAndWarnings: The successful dotnet-format gate emitted a generic workspace-loading warning. This review does not claim warning-free project loading or infer an omitted check without concrete evidence. Full solution build succeeded with zero warnings/errors and all required component gates executed.
Clippy completed under -D warnings, but Cargo emitted an unused-manifest-dependency warning and its summary. This review does not claim a warning-free Cargo log.

All 56 outer regression logs were independently rehashed. Sanitized nested component JSON and recorded child-log digests are authenticated by the artifact; nested raw component/process logs absent from the uploaded artifact were not independently rehashed.

Source maps available in six uploaded inventories were compared to immutable 7255040 Git blobs. Digests-only component source manifests are retained as such, not relabeled as independently reconstructed inventories.

Provider component receipts deliberately do not claim full Database Host acceptance. Separate full Host, migrations, materialization, Fluent and relations suites establish actual two-provider integration.
Existing bounded composition/allocation instrumentation remains historical regression coverage; no old Perf-01 optimization or long-running benchmark was executed by this reviewer.
